Nerium oleander ( / ˈ n ɪər i ə m ... / NEER -ee-əm ), [ 2 ] commonly known as oleander, rose laurel , be-still tree or rosebay , [ 3 ] [ 4 ] is a shrub or small tree cultivated worldwide in temperate and subtropical areas as an ornamental and landscaping plant. It is the only species currently classified in the genus Nerium , belonging to subfamily Apocynoideae of the dogbane family Apocynaceae . It is so widely cultivated that no precise region of origin has been identified, though it is usually associated with the Mediterranean Basin .
